title: Use Robot Selection “Go to” to send an AGV (not in a task) to a chosen map square
summary: Use the OptiSweep map-based Robot Selection “Go to” function to reposition an AGV that is not currently in a task. The procedure sends the selected AGV to a chosen destination square and is presented as a quick recovery method when an AGV cannot leave an area.
when_to_use: When an AGV is not in a task and you need to quickly reposition it to a chosen square (e.g., the source example: a tipper goes down and an AGV will not leave; use Go-to to drop it off at the hospital).
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Robot Selection object selection and Go-to flow on the OptiSweep map UI to send the selected AGV to the chosen destination square.
access_or_tools_needed: OptiSweep map UI that supports selecting operational objects (AGVs and cells/squares)
Robot Selection panel/controls including “Go to” and “Confirm”

system_preconditions: The target AGV is not currently in a task (the source describes Go-to for an AGV not in a task).

visual_references.description: Robot Selection Go-to function flow and the 4-step sequence: Select an AGV → Select Go to → Select destination square → Select Confirm; includes note that generic map clicks do nothing because the map cannot infer whether you meant an AGV vs a cell.

steps.title: Select the specific AGV object on the map (not a generic map click)
steps.purpose: Ensure the UI knows you intend to act on an AGV (the source states generic map clicks do nothing because the map cannot infer whether you are selecting an AGV or a cell).
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep map UI, select the specific AGV object (object selection). Do not just click on the map background.
steps.expected_result: The selected AGV is identified for the Robot Selection flow (i.e., you are positioned to proceed to the “Go to” selection for that AGV).
steps.healthy_condition: You have selected an AGV object (not a generic map click), consistent with the source explanation that object selection is required for actions.
steps.failure_condition: You click on the map without selecting an AGV object; no action is triggered because the map cannot infer whether you meant an AGV or a cell.
stop_or_escalate_if: If clicking on the map does nothing, stop and re-do the step by selecting an AGV object (not a generic map click).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “These are the objects that you can select on the map. So if you just click on the map, nothing will happen because the map doesn't know if you're trying to select an AGB or a cell...” and “1. Select an AGV”

steps.title: Select “Go to” for the selected AGV
steps.purpose: Enter the Robot Selection “Go-to” function for the selected AGV.
steps.instruction: After selecting the AGV object, choose the Robot Selection “Go to” function for that AGV.
steps.expected_result: The “Go to” flow is active for the selected AGV, allowing you to choose a destination square.
steps.healthy_condition: You can proceed to the next selection: choosing which square the AGV should go to.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot proceed to select a destination square (indicating the “Go to” function was not selected for the AGV).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Robot Selection Go-to function… 1. Select an AGV 2. Select Go to”

steps.title: Select the destination square on the map
steps.purpose: Choose the exact map square the AGV should be sent to.
steps.instruction: In the “Go to” flow, select the destination square on the map grid/squares (the source describes selecting which square you want the AGV to go to).
steps.expected_result: A destination square is selected as the target for the Go-to command.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI is ready for confirmation of the selected destination square (next step is “Confirm”).
steps.failure_condition: No destination square is selected/accepted for the Go-to flow.

actions.label: Select destination square
actions.exact_action: Select which square you want the AGV to go to

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “3. Select which square you want the AGV to go to”

steps.title: Select “Confirm” to send the AGV to the chosen square
steps.purpose: Transmit the Go-to command to move the selected AGV to the selected destination square.
steps.instruction: Select “Confirm” in the Robot Selection Go-to flow to send the AGV to the chosen square.
steps.expected_result: The selected AGV is sent to the chosen square using the Go-to function.
steps.healthy_condition: The Go-to action completes (the source frames this as the AGV being sent to the chosen square; the example recovery is dropping off at the hospital).
steps.failure_condition: After Confirm, the AGV does not move to the selected square.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the AGV does not move to the selected square after Confirm (the source provides no additional troubleshooting beyond the Go-to flow).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Robot Selection Go-to function… An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square… 4. Select Confirm.” and “Stop and escalate if the AGV does not move to the selected square after Confirm” (from candidate failure notes).

success_criteria: After selecting Confirm, the selected AGV is sent to the chosen destination square (observable movement to the selected square).
healthy_conditions: The map action is triggered only after selecting an AGV object (not a generic map click).
The Go-to flow proceeds through selecting destination square and Confirm.
failure_conditions: Generic map click results in no action because the map cannot infer whether you intended an AGV or a cell.
After Confirm, the AGV does not move to the selected square.
escalation_guidance: If the AGV does not move to the selected square after Confirm, stop and escalate. The source does not provide additional troubleshooting steps beyond the Go-to flow.
